leadText: (Japanese: ポケットモンスター～ぷっちぐみ ～ ぺん Pocket Monsters ~Pucchigumi SP~ Part One) is the first chapter of the Pocket Monsters ~Pucchigumi SP~ manga. It was first published in the June / July 2023 issue of , released on April 28, 2023. It briefly summarizes the main events from The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) to For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!. It is 12 pages long.
